claim: LEGAL-BERT is a family of legal-domain BERT models pre-trained on 12 GB of legal text.
LEDGAR contains more than 12,000 labels, almost 100,000 provisions, and more than 60,000 contracts.
ContractNLI contains 607 annotated contracts for document-level NLI.
CLAUDETTE dataset has 21,063 sentences with 2,346 unfair sentences.
Moon construction specification risk detection used 2,807 clauses from 56 specifications.
Moon BERT achieved validation accuracy 0.889 and test F1 0.934 on construction risks.
Shuai unilateral contractual change risk framework uses rationale-augmented NLP.
Zhou missing clause detection model tested on 1,322 construction contracts.
Zhou MatchPyramid+BERT achieved 93% classification and 83% similarity accuracy.
LCC survey identified 7 key tasks and 8 significant challenges.
ContractEval evaluates LLM clause-level risk identification.
CUAD dataset is released under CC BY 4.0; underlying contract rights remain subject to the source/disclaimer conditions.
ContractNLI dataset is licensed under CC BY 4.0 (baseline code is Apache 2.0).
CLAUDETTE license is not explicitly verified from authoritative source.
Moon et al. construction dataset has no official public dataset download/repository independently verified.
Shuai construction dataset has no official public dataset download/repository independently verified.
Zhou construction dataset has no official public dataset download/repository independently verified.
